examples.en: In calligraphy class, I ground an ink stick on the inkstone.
My grandfather's inkstone is very old.
I received an inkstone and a brush as a gift.
Please carry the inkstone carefully so it doesn't break.
I saw a Joseon-era inkstone at the museum.

examples.ko: 벼루에 물을 조금 붓고 먹을 천천히 갈아요.
examples.en: Pour a little water on the inkstone and slowly grind the ink stick.

explain: 먹을 가는 도구라서 '벼루에 먹을 갈다'라고 같이 말해요. 붓, 먹, 종이와 함께 서예를 이야기할 때 나와요.

phrases.en: I prepared a brush and an inkstone for calligraphy class.
phrases.nuance_ko: 서예 도구와 함께 말할 때 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing when talking about calligraphy tools.

phrases.en: After class I wiped the inkstone clean.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사용한 뒤에 정리하는 행동이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The action of cleaning up after use.

phrases.en: You need an inkstone and an ink stick to do calligraphy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹을 가는 두 가지 도구를 같이 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the two tools used together to grind ink.

explain_en: It is the tool for grinding ink, so it goes with '먹을 갈다' (to grind an ink stick). It appears with brush, ink stick and paper when talking about calligraphy.

examples.en: I painted with acrylic paint.
This sweater is acrylic, so it is warm and light.
We put up an acrylic sign in front of the shop.
Acrylic sheets are harder to break than glass.
My friend gave me a keychain made of acrylic.
I put the photo inside an acrylic case.

explain: '아크릴'은 유리처럼 투명한 플라스틱, 또는 천을 만드는 인조 섬유를 말해요. 한국에서는 간판, 케이스, 키링에 쓰는 투명 판을 부를 때, 그리고 아크릴 물감을 말할 때 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: Acrylic paint dries quickly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그림 재료를 말할 때 가장 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common use, for art supplies.

phrases.en: I made a small box out of an acrylic sheet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 투명하고 단단한 판을 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to a clear, hard plastic sheet.

phrases.en: I put the card in an acrylic case.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건을 보호하는 투명 케이스를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A clear case used to protect items.

explain_en: 아크릴 is a glass-clear plastic, and also a man-made fiber used in fabric. In Korea you hear it most for transparent sheets used in signs, cases and keyrings, and for acrylic paint.

examples.en: This charger is compatible with all mobile phones.

examples.ko: 새 프로그램이 옛 파일과 호환되는지 확인했어요.
examples.en: I checked whether the new program is compatible with old files.

examples.ko: 두 회사의 부품은 서로 호환되지 않아요.
examples.en: The parts of the two companies are not compatible with each other.
You have to buy a compatible cable.

examples.ko: 이 게임은 컴퓨터와도 휴대폰과도 호환될 거예요.
examples.en: This game will be compatible with both computers and phones.
It was said to be compatible so I bought it, but it did not fit.

explain: 기계, 부품, 프로그램이 서로 바꾸어 써도 문제없이 작동한다는 말이에요. '맞다'는 크기나 모양이 딱 맞는 것이고, '호환되다'는 다른 회사나 다른 버전끼리도 함께 쓸 수 있다는 뜻으로 컴퓨터와 전자제품 이야기에 자주 나와요. 보통 '~와/과 호환되다'를 써요.

phrases.example: 옛날 앱은 새 휴대폰과 호환되지 않아요.
phrases.en: The old app is not compatible with the new phone.
phrases.nuance_ko: 서로 함께 쓸 수 없다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say two things cannot be used together.

phrases.example: 사기 전에 제 휴대폰과 호환되는지 확인했어요.
phrases.en: Before buying it, I checked whether it was compatible with my phone.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제품을 사거나 설치하기 전에 함께 쓸 수 있는지 알아볼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when checking whether things work together before buying or installing.

phrases.en: The two products are compatible with each other.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제품 설명에서 함께 쓸 수 있다고 알릴 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in product descriptions to say things can be used together.

explain_en: Machines, parts or programs are 호환되다 when they work together or can be swapped without trouble. 맞다 is a physical fit in size or shape; 호환되다 means products or versions from different makers or releases work with each other, common in computer and electronics talk. The pattern is ~와/과 호환되다.

en: to accelerate; to gain speed; to intensify

examples.en: The government decided to speed up the reforms.
The company sped up the development of the new product.

examples.ko: 기후 변화가 빙하가 녹는 속도를 가속화해요.
examples.en: Climate change speeds up the rate at which glaciers melt.
To speed up the schedule, we need more people.

examples.ko: 경쟁이 심해지면서 기업들이 투자를 가속화하고 있어요.
examples.en: As competition grows, companies are accelerating their investments.

examples.ko: 도시 개발을 가속화하면 환경 문제가 생길 수 있어요.
examples.en: If urban development is accelerated, environmental problems may arise.

explain: 개혁, 개발, 투자처럼 큰 일의 속도를 더 빠르게 만든다고 할 때 써요. 뉴스와 회의에서 많이 들리고, 일상에서는 '서두르다, 빨리하다'가 더 자연스러워요. 일이 저절로 빨라질 때는 '가속화되다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: Economic growth is accelerating.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일이 저절로 빨라질 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something speeds up on its own.

phrases.en: The deadline is near, so we sped up the work.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상에서 더 자연스러운 쉬운 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier and more natural phrase in daily life.

phrases.en: The company is speeding up its overseas expansion.
phrases.nuance_ko: 진행 중인 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for something that is in progress.

explain_en: Formal; makes a project, trend or change move faster. It is used when making the pace of big things like reforms, development or investment faster. You hear it often in news and meetings, while in daily life '서두르다' or '빨리하다' sounds more natural. When something speeds up on its own, people say '가속화되다'.

t90.ax: To speed up the schedule, we need more people.

examples.ko: 신청 절차를 간소화해서 서류가 두 장으로 줄었어요.
examples.en: They simplified the application process, so the documents dropped to two pages.
City Hall simplified its complaint handling process.
I wish they would simplify the complicated rules.

examples.ko: 짐을 줄이려고 여행 준비를 간소화하려고 해요.
examples.en: I want to simplify my travel preparation to cut down on luggage.

examples.ko: 결혼식 절차를 간소화하는 부부가 늘고 있어요.
examples.en: More and more couples are simplifying their wedding procedures.
The company decided to simplify its approval steps.

explain: '간단하게 하다'와 같은 뜻이지만 절차, 서류, 제도처럼 단계가 있는 것에 잘 어울려요. '복잡하게 하다'와 반대이고, '절차가 간소화돼요'처럼 피동으로도 말해요.

phrases.en: These days, applying for a passport has been simplified a lot.
phrases.nuance_ko: 피동 표현으로, 절차나 제도가 간단하게 바뀐 결과를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A passive form used to describe the result of a process or system being made simpler.

phrases.en: Complicated rules need to be simplified.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 형태로 바꿔 필요성을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The noun form is used to talk about a need.

phrases.en: The company is trying to simplify the reporting method.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 하려는 계획을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe a plan to do it.

explain_en: Making procedures or systems less complicated, formal/official (절차를 간소화하다) It means the same as '간단하게 하다' (make simple), but fits things with steps such as procedures, paperwork and systems. Its opposite is '복잡하게 하다', and you can also say it passively: '절차가 간소화돼요'.

t90.ax: I wish they would simplify the complicated rules.

examples.ko: 이 가게는 고급품만 팔아서 값이 비싸요.
examples.en: This shop only sells high-end goods, so it's expensive.
I'd like to buy you a high-quality item as a gift.
It's a premium product, so it doesn't break even after long use.
There's a reason premium goods cost so much.
The department store has a separate section for luxury goods.
I prefer practical things to high-end products.

explain: '명품'은 이름난 브랜드의 물건을 말할 때 많이 쓰고, '고급품'은 품질이 좋은 물건 전체에 써요. 반대로 값싸고 질이 낮은 물건은 '저가품'이나 '싸구려'라고 해요.

phrases.en: That bag is a luxury item from a famous brand.
phrases.nuance_ko: 고급품 중에서도 이름난 브랜드의 물건을 말할 때 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for luxury goods from famous brands.

phrases.en: It's a gift for my parents, so I chose a high-quality item.
phrases.nuance_ko: 품질 좋은 물건을 선택하는 상황에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when choosing a good-quality item.

phrases.en: Because it's high-end, it stays sturdy even after long use.
phrases.nuance_ko: 값이 비싸거나 품질이 좋은 이유를 말할 때 이어서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to give the reason for high price or quality.

explain_en: '명품' is often used for famous-brand goods, while '고급품' covers any item of good quality. The opposite is '저가품' or '싸구려' for cheap, low-quality goods.

examples.en: This app works like a map.

examples.ko: 약이 제대로 기능하지 않는 것 같아요.
examples.en: The medicine doesn't seem to be working properly.
That room also served as a study.

examples.ko: 몸의 모든 부분이 함께 기능하는 거예요.
examples.en: All parts of the body function together.
This rule will serve as a guide.
The system is functioning well, so there's no problem.

explain: 기계의 작동보다는 어떤 것이 맡은 역할을 한다는 뜻에서 자주 써요. 'A로 기능하다'는 'A 역할을 하다'와 같아요. 기계가 움직인다고 할 때는 '작동하다', '돌아가다'를 더 많이 써요.

phrases.en: The new system functions properly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 맡은 역할을 잘 해낼 때 '제대로'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with 제대로 when something does its job well.

phrases.en: This rule no longer functions.
phrases.nuance_ko: 역할을 하지 못하는 상황을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something fails to play its role.

phrases.en: This room serves as a study.
phrases.nuance_ko: 'A 역할을 하다'는 'A로 기능하다'와 같은 뜻이고 말할 때 더 쉬워요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'A 역할을 하다' means the same as 'A로 기능하다' and is easier in speech.
phrases.en_equiv: serves as / plays the role of

explain_en: It is used more for something playing its role than for a machine running. 'Function as A' means to act in the role of A. For machines simply running, other verbs meaning 'operate' or 'run' are more common.

examples.ko: 서류 단순화 덕분에 신청이 훨씬 쉬워졌어요.
examples.en: Thanks to the simplified paperwork, applying became much easier.
Many people say the procedure needs to be simplified.

examples.ko: 단순화는 편리하지만 중요한 내용이 빠질 수도 있어요.
examples.en: Simplification is convenient, but important content can get left out.

examples.ko: 이 앱은 디자인 단순화로 인기를 얻었어요.
examples.en: This app became popular through its simplified design.
Complicated explanations need simplifying.

examples.ko: 회사는 결재 단계의 단순화를 추진하고 있어요.
examples.en: The company is pushing to simplify the approval steps.

explain: 복잡한 것을 간단하게 만드는 일이에요. '간소화'는 절차를 줄여서 간단히 한다는 느낌으로 행정 뉴스에 자주 나오고, '단순화'는 구조나 설명을 쉽게 만들 때도 써요. 너무 단순화하면 중요한 부분이 빠질 수 있다는 뜻으로도 자주 말해요.

phrases.en: Simplifying the application procedure is necessary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 절차를 줄여서 간단하게 만든다는 뜻으로 행정 이야기에 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means trimming a procedure to make it simple, common in administrative talk.

phrases.en: If you simplify the design, it looks cleaner.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 '단순화'에 '를 하다'를 붙인 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds '를 하다' to the noun '단순화'.

phrases.en: That explanation is an oversimplification.
phrases.nuance_ko: 너무 단순하게 해서 중요한 부분이 빠졌다는 안 좋은 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Has a negative meaning: made so simple that important parts are lost.

explain_en: Making something less complex, like procedures or designs; not merging into one. It is the act of making something complicated simple. '간소화' feels like cutting down procedures and often appears in administrative news, while '단순화' is also used for making structures or explanations easier. People often use it to warn that oversimplifying can lose important parts.

examples.en: Write the correct answer inside the square brackets.
I marked the title in square brackets at the start of the sentence.
In math, you use square brackets after parentheses.
What is inside the square brackets is an explanation.

examples.ko: 인용문에 설명을 덧붙일 때 대괄호를 사용해요.
examples.en: When adding an explanation to a quotation, you use square brackets.

examples.ko: 제목 앞에 대괄호가 붙어 있어서 공지인 줄 알았어요.
examples.en: The title had square brackets in front, so I thought it was a notice.

explain: [ ] 모양의 괄호예요. ( )는 '소괄호', { }는 '중괄호'라고 해요. 게시글 제목에서 [공지]처럼 말머리를 표시할 때도 자주 써요.

phrases.en: Write your name inside the square brackets.
phrases.nuance_ko: 괄호 속 내용을 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to point to what is inside the brackets.

phrases.en: Please put the title in square brackets.
phrases.nuance_ko: 글의 일부를 괄호로 감쌀 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when enclosing part of the text in brackets.

phrases.en: Please use parentheses here.
phrases.nuance_ko: ( ) 모양 괄호를 말하며 대괄호와 구분해서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: It means ( ) and is distinguished from square brackets.

explain_en: It is the bracket shaped like [ ]. ( ) is '소괄호' and { } is '중괄호'. It is also often used to mark tags on post titles, such as [공지].

examples.en: Korean words correspond to English words.

examples.ko: 표를 보면 숫자가 글자와 대응된다는 걸 알 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you look at the table, you can see the numbers match the letters.

examples.ko: 이 말은 영어로 정확히 대응되지 않아요.
examples.en: This word doesn't have an exact English counterpart.
Find the answer that matches each question.
The colors are matched to numbers.
Connect them with a line so they correspond to each other.

explain: '대응되다'는 두 개가 서로 짝이 맞을 때 써요. '~에 대응되다'로 말하고, 번역이나 표, 문제와 답 같은 설명에 자주 나와요. 상황에 맞게 행동하는 '대응하다'와는 달라요.

phrases.en: The two expressions correspond to each other.
phrases.nuance_ko: 두 개가 짝을 이룰 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when two things form a pair.

phrases.en: I'm looking for the Korean that corresponds to the English word.
phrases.nuance_ko: 번역이나 사전 설명에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used in translation or dictionary explanations.

phrases.en: In the table, the numbers and letters match up.
phrases.nuance_ko: '대응되다'보다 쉬운 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier expression than '대응되다'.

explain_en: Two things pair off, like words across languages. 대응되다 is used when two things pair up with each other, as in '~에 대응되다'. It often appears in explanations about translation, tables, and questions and answers. It differs from 대응하다, which means to respond to a situation.

examples.ko: 두 서류의 동일성 여부를 확인해 주세요.
examples.en: Please check whether the two documents are identical.

examples.ko: 이 연구는 두 집단의 동일성이 먼저 증명되어야 해요.
examples.en: For this study, the sameness of the two groups must be proven first.
It's hard to judge identity from the photo alone.

examples.ko: 문화마다 동일성보다 다양성을 중요하게 생각할 때도 있어요.
examples.en: In some cultures, diversity is considered more important than uniformity.

examples.ko: 모습이 바뀌어도 나라는 동일성은 유지된다고 생각해요.
examples.en: I think my identity as myself stays the same even if my appearance changes.

examples.ko: 데이터의 동일성이 깨지면 시스템에 오류가 나요.
examples.en: If the consistency of the data breaks, the system gets errors.

explain: '같음'이나 '똑같다'보다 딱딱해서 철학, 법, 연구 글에서 많이 써요. 반대로 쓰는 말은 '다양성'이고, '동일성 여부', '동일성을 유지하다'처럼 자주 짝지어요.

phrases.example: 두 글씨의 동일성 여부를 조사하고 있어요.
phrases.en: They are investigating whether the two handwritings are the same.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 것인지 아닌지를 따질 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing, used for judging whether two things are the same.

phrases.en: I confirmed that the two contract copies are identical.
phrases.nuance_ko: 두 대상이 똑같은지 직접 살펴볼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when you check that two things are really the same.

phrases.en: The two cases were recognized as the same.
phrases.nuance_ko: 법이나 연구 글에서 같다고 판단되었을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in legal or research writing when something is judged to be the same.

explain_en: It is stiffer than '같음' or '똑같다' and is common in philosophy, law and research writing. A contrasting word is '다양성' (diversity), and it often pairs as '동일성 여부' (whether it is identical) or '동일성을 유지하다' (maintain identity).

t90.ax: It's hard to judge identity from the photo alone.

examples.ko: 이 물은 무색이라서 맛도 냄새도 없어요.
examples.en: This water is colorless, so it has no taste or smell.
I put the medicine in a colorless, transparent bottle.

examples.ko: 무색에 가까운 액체가 컵에 담겨 있어요.
examples.en: A nearly colorless liquid is in the cup.

examples.ko: 무색으로 된 유리는 빛이 잘 통해요.
examples.en: Colorless glass lets light through well.

examples.ko: 화학 시간에 무색 용액이 붉게 변하는 걸 봤어요.
examples.en: In chemistry class I saw a colorless solution turn red.
Before the paint was mixed in, it was colorless glue.

explain: '무색 투명', '무색무취'처럼 굳은 표현으로 자주 나와요. 일상 대화에서는 물이나 유리를 '투명하다'고 해요. 형용사 '무색하다'는 '민망하다'에 가까운 전혀 다른 말이에요.

phrases.example: 이 병은 무색 투명해서 안이 다 보여요.
phrases.en: This bottle is colorless and transparent, so you can see everything inside.
phrases.nuance_ko: 색이 없고 속이 보이는 것을 함께 말하는 굳은 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A set phrase meaning both colorless and see-through.

phrases.en: This gas is colorless and odorless, so it is hard to notice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 색도 냄새도 없을 때 한 단어처럼 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used almost as one word when something has neither color nor smell.

phrases.en: There is a colorless liquid in the cup.
phrases.nuance_ko: '무색의'로 뒤의 명사를 꾸밀 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: '무색의' can describe the noun that follows.

explain_en: It appears mostly in fixed phrases like 무색 투명 and 무색무취. In everyday talk, water or glass is described as 투명하다. The adjective 무색하다 is a completely different word, closer to feeling embarrassed.
